weapon_library.description: Size each trade so a stop hit cannot exceed the per-position NAV loss budget.
Cap leverage so stop-to-entry distance does not consume too much margin on stop.
Reject new risk after the account daily loss limit is reached.
Do not add repeated exposure to a symbol already owned by position management.
Reduce notional when the book is already concentrated on the same side.
Reduce or veto when OKX Kit smartmoney/news/OI signals disagree with the model.
Allow up to 5x only under explicit aggressive mode, external confirmation, and zero risk flags.
For each trend-pullback candidate strategy, cap allocated margin budget at 50U, each order at 10U, and open positions at three.
When the three trend-pullback candidate strategies request the same symbol simultaneously, accept at most one in priority order: cluster_elite_quality60, quality_top20, rank_top1.
